1.    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* not measured: none of its declarations is in the spine run the measure reads.
3. Pullback range (pullbackLinear f) matches fiber-constant maps (mem_range_pullbackLinear_iff); under exact FiberLumpable f K, this K-invariant subspace has finrank <= Fintype.card O, compressing survival indistinguishability to length <= Fintype.card O - 1 (survival_indistinguishable_iff_le_obs_pred; substochastic witness lumpable_obs_horizon_one_witness). <a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- Lean v4.30.0-rc2 + Mathlib standard axioms [Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext] in Mathlib periphery module FiniteProbKrylov; requires [Fintype] carriers, [Nonempty U] only for optimal_query_tv_floor attainment, and [Nonempty S] for card - 1 theorems, whereas krylovSub_stabilizes_before_rank holds for any v₀ in K-invariant W including v₀ = 0 and W = ⊥.
- survival_indistinguishable_iff_le_obs_pred assumes exact FiberLumpable f K on real matrices; when interpreted probabilistically, the observable-horizon reduction is non-trivial only for substochastic survival matrices (normalized Markov kernels yield survVec = 1 unconditionally).

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Normalized stochastic Markov kernels trivially satisfy survVec K w s = 1 for all words w, so FiberLumpable observable-horizon reduction carries distinguishing power only for substochastic or general real survival/reward matrices.
- FiberLumpable is an intrinsic invariance on K; for prescribed (K, L) it does not force zero rowDefect without a compatible L (fixed_macro_nonzero_rowDefect_witness).
- Does not prove that empirical transition dynamics are finite, time-homogeneous, or exactly FiberLumpable (Rule 2).
- **Counterexample:** empty_source_infeasible refutes FinDist U under IsEmpty U; lumpable_obs_horizon_one_witness gives a substochastic 3-state/2-observation FiberLumpable system where length-0 agrees and length 1 = card Bool - 1 < card (Fin 3) - 1 separates.
